MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small Gorilla tape roll fits my current home projects because it could help with temporary holds and patches alongside framing and mounting work.",
    "Its single compact roll gives me a useful project supply in a quantity I would realistically choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Nuts, hose clamps, and metal-cutting wheels serve different fastening or cutting tasks from the wood screws, framing nails, and drywall anchors I recently needed.",
    "The epoxies, temperature gun, and electronic cleaner assume specific repair or measurement needs I have not shown.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape and twelve wastebaskets exceed my current needs; the usefulness of one small tape roll does not extend to a bulk purchase."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply, although the actual task matters to me.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase seems to have been stretched into a need for other cleaning-related supplies, even though replacement bags do not imply a need for wastebaskets."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of wood screws, framing nails, and drywall anchors point toward wood fastening and mounting work, where dimensions and compatibility matter.",
    "Quantity matters for each supply: using boxes of fasteners does not mean I need bulk quantities of tape or household equipment.",
    "I choose additional supplies when they have a clear use in my current projects, rather than simply because they could be handy someday."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical project needs but extended them too broadly into unrelated repairs and excessive quantities."
}
